title: Home Lens room tags (hand-off from the room scan to the document matcher)

capturedAt.description: When the move-in scan was done

object.description: What is damaged, lowercase noun: carpet, wall, door, window, blinds, counter, floor, ceiling, appliance, fixture, other

note.description: Short visible description, e.g. 'dark stain near closet, ~8 in'

photo.description: Relative path or data URL of the photo the tag is on

box.description: Optional [x, y, w, h] in 0-1 photo coordinates

pose.description: Optional VSLAM camera position/orientation for 3D placement

confirmed.description: true once the renter has confirmed the tag
